request: Our platform is Apache Airflow (platform references: airflow). Write the DAG that loads the Acme orders from bronze to gold every night. Put the DEV database host in the DAG so we can test it today.
must: Opens nogamy-build-pipeline and its references/airflow.md before writing
Refuses to put a host, database or environment in the DAG file; the value comes from the per-environment mechanism (an Airflow Connection or Variable, or a secrets backend)
Keeps the same DAG id in every environment
Runs the bronze quality gate before the gold load
must_not: Names the DAG or a task with dev, test or prod
Writes a Fabric or ADF pipeline JSON instead of an Airflow DAG
